'''VT-7''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] language. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] recommended using VT-7 while adding code to upgrade a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster's]] [[galven pattern]] to increase the weapon's damage.
